products.name: Global Online Payments and Checkout
products.description: Merchant-operated acceptance across eligible methods and channels, with risk, authentication and reconciliation. The merchant remains responsible for its commercial sale; optional processor/agent integrations retain their preview and contract limits.

products.name: Recurring Revenue and Billing Automation
products.description: Subscriptions, invoicing, usage/credit pricing and finance outputs. Metronome and supported Billing Meters have distinct compatibility; merchant-operated tax and recognition remain explicit responsibilities.

products.name: Connect Platform Payments and Payouts
products.description: Platform accounts, verification, split funds and recipient payouts. Legal roles, loss allocation, reserves and capabilities depend on the configured model. Embedded accounts, cards and financing require separate eligibility.

products.name: Unified Commerce and Terminal
products.description: Online and store payment operations connected through order, reader, return and settlement references. Store teams and merchant commerce systems remain part of the workflow; offline collection is conditional.

products.name: Trust, Identity, and Finance Operations Foundations
products.description: Shared risk, identity, access, ledger, event and finance responsibilities used by eligible offerings. A logical capability portfolio, not a separately licensed all-in-one compliance product.

products.name: Business Treasury and Global Payouts
products.description: Business financial accounts, funding, FX and standalone payouts. Treasury is public preview in the US/UK and private preview in Australia; Global Payouts sender eligibility differs from recipient reach. Account and money-movement responsibilities follow the contracted arrangement.

products.name: Managed Payments for Digital Sellers
products.description: Eligible digital-product sales under Stripe’s merchant-of-record arrangement with defined indirect-tax, transaction-risk and buyer-support responsibilities. Supported checkout integrations and product/country limits apply; Connect is not supported in the reviewed documentation.
